The June 2022 AI-regulation paper’s figure has six endpoint labels: Standardization, Localization, Utilitarianism, Egalitarianism, Consequential, Deontological.  
A Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph) article submitted to arXiv on 11 Aug 2016 discusses transitions between egalitarian and hierarchical societies, repeatedly using the phrase “egalitarian society.”  
Among the six label words, the one appearing (as part of “egalitarian society”) is Egalitarianism.

Finding Nemo’s star is the ocellaris clownfish (Amphiprion ocellaris). According to the USGS Nonindigenous Aquatic Species (NAS) database, this species was recorded (before 2020) in two Florida coastal localities: Dania Beach in Broward County and the Peanut Island/Riviera Beach area in Palm Beach County. The primary ZIP codes associated with these places are 33004 (Dania Beach) and 33404 (Riviera Beach/Peanut Island).
